text:
cheng li: ok team — planning a sequential fractional shift for the router/LB change tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. want to lock down steps and rollback gates.

maria r: steps? typical would be 1%, 5%, 25%, 75%, 100% but given recent p95 sensitivity maybe smaller.

sam p: +1 on smaller. propose: 0.5%, 2%, 10%, 40%, 100% with 10–15m observe between steps.

elaine: request: keep session-affinity pinned for the first two steps to avoid user churn. we can relax after 10% if stable.

cheng li: agree. also pin model-version=v2.1.3 on route-tag=canary for the trial. release notes: https://docs.redwood/release/v2.1.3 (contains config diffs & known-issues)

oncall-jordan: set hard rollback triggers: error-rate increase >1% absolute, or p95 latency >300ms sustained for 5m, or CPU on router pods >85% for 3m. If any trigger fires — immediate revert to v1 and start drain.

maria r: add health-check gate for 0.5% -> 2%: 5m green (0 errors, p95 < 250ms) or else hold & investigate.

sam p: ops checklist before start: 1) certs checked, 2) lb rules validated, 3) health checks sync across AZs, 4) capacity reserve of +20%. I’ll verify 1–3 now.

ops-bot: monitor links: https://ops.redwood/metrics/teams/router?window=30m | live dashboard: https://ops.redwood/dash/router-live

cheng li: we will do manual advanc e between steps (no automated progression) to let SRE call the go/no-go. SRE to call "advance" or "rollback" in-thread.

elaine: note about cookies: we will set cookie_ttl=2h for affinity. update nginx config at start-of-window. Sam — can you push the config delta as a small PR and link it here?

sam p: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/router-config/pulls/412 — contains cookie_ttl and weight-ramp settings. merging scheduled at 01:50 UTC, right before cutover.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot started rollout job 5234567890: planning fractional shift. current state: PREPARED.

cheng li: ordering and timing: start at 02:10 UTC with 0.5% (target duration 10m), observe 10m; if good, move to 2% at ~02:30, observe 15m; 10% at ~02:55 observe 15m; 40% at ~03:20 observe 20m; final 100% by ~03:50. keep a 10m buffer for rollback.

oncall-jordan: I'll be on-call in the window. tagging SRE: @oncall-jordan. If we need a fast rollback, use this command on the router control plane: 

```bash
# revert weights to stable
curl -X POST https://router-api/v1/weights/revert -d '{"target":"stable"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN"
```

cheng li: good. last items: confirm obs alerts are muted for noisy flapping metrics but critical alerts remain (error-rate, latency, cpu). ops-bot, mute the noisy alert group for 90m.

ops-bot: muted alert group "router-flapping" for 90m (muted_by: cheng li).

maria r: sanity check: are we using gradual draining on rollback? we should drain v2 with connection drain-time=30s then stop traffic.

elaine: yes — drain-time=30s, then scale v2 down after drain completion. will coordinate scaling.

deploy-bot: rollout job 5234567890: STEP 1 queued (0.5%). waiting for manual advance.

cheng li: final: everyone ok with plan? please reply with :thumbsup: to acknowledge and be present for the window.

maria r: :thumbsup:

sam p: :thumbsup: I’ll push the config PR and stand by.

elaine: :thumbsup:

oncall-jordan: :thumbsup: oncall available.

cheng li: Great — see you in #eng-releases at 02:00 UTC for preflight check. I’ll post a short preflight thread 30m before start.
